raptor.title: Raptor: Call of the Shadows

source.imported: Upstream tree imported into this repository at 90a24e0; build-amiga.sh builds it as imported, with patches/ applied to a copy

raptor.contentPolicy: GPL-2.0 engine (LICENSE). The game data is not part of the engine: the publisher's shareware episode (Apogee's v1.2, episode 1) is fetched on the PC that stages a lab, checked against gameports/runtime-data.json, and never committed or packaged.
raptor.stageEvidence: README.md, Observed 2 November 2026: lab:raptor, patches 0001-0004, open4 build; title, menus and flight on a 320x200 screen of its own; keyboard and mouse; Bravo wave 1 flown (to its end only in upstream's developer mode); 23.3 frames a second in flight (the game's pace); AHI fed in time in steady play, not heard; saves and settings kept across a cold start; three whole-lab stops, cause not established; pads not exercised.
